items.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021
items.q: There’s another group I play with too that Ellen Rowe at the University of Michigan started... Tia Fuller and Melissa on trombone.

ctx.x: Yeah. But speaking about reaching out to an audience, it was so inclusive and there was a whole crowd of junior high kids there and they came up on the stage afterwards and I was just watching this whole thing I said this is exactly what we need.

Yes. There’s another group I play with too that Ellen Rowe at the University of Michigan started in 2017 mainly because she’s been teaching there for twenty years and there’s still not enough young women going into improvised music at college and at the high school level as well so she formed together a group to do outreach and we’ve had to put plans on © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

hold but we are going to be doing some stuff in January. Great group. We did a recording in 2017 so Ellen, Marian, in Detroit, oh my God, I’m having a mental blank. Bass player from Detroit, oh my gosh. Oh that’s terrible. Allison Miller on drums, the front line Ingrid Jensen, Virginia Mayhew, Tia Fuller and Melissa on trombone. Sorry. I haven’t seen these people for a while, I’m forgetting everyone’s last names.
